The system fabricated the dish name "duck confit" as the final answer without any real evidence or verification that it existed in the March 22, 2021 menu and was absent on April 21, 2021. This constitutes a language-only hallucination.

No actual search or data retrieval was performed; the system repeated task prompts without accessing the Wayback Machine. This failure to retrieve necessary information is a poor information retrieval error.
